audit_items.proof_trace: The `refundExpired` pre-condition is enforced by the `whenRefundPeriodIsOver` modifier on both transfer entry points. The `positions[target].investedCapital == 0` pre-condition is intentionally NOT enforced; instead, `_burnOrTransferInvestorPosition` (L571-601) explicitly implements merge semantics when the target already holds a position, validating the target position's state (not refunded, has claimed excess) before merging. Both transfer paths are gated by Legion-level authorization (`onlyLegion` or a valid `legionSigner` signature), confirming this is by design.
